sections.voiceover: In East Sussex on August 9, 2025, locomotives moved unsafely while coupling. Brighton Locals Newsroom confirmed that nobody was injured. How did the Bluebell Railway, a heritage line in East Sussex, fail during locomotive coupling?
sections.visual_cue: Map graphic highlighting East Sussex and Sheffield Park station location

Brighton Locals Newsroom report headline layout

sections.voiceover: However, the Rail Accident Investigation Branch published Report 11 on October 8, 2026, detailing risks.
sections.visual_cue: Official government investigation report document header

sections.voiceover: Investigators found that unsafe locomotive movements occurred during the coupling process at Sheffield Park. The Bluebell Railway, a heritage line, must now evaluate all vehicle coupling procedures after 2025.

sections.voiceover: Report 11 requires safer coupling arrangements for Bluebell Railway operations.
